name: estudio-de-contenidos
description: Self-hosted content studio: review, approval and publishing of content pieces for one or several brands.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @estudio/api && npm run build -w @estudio/web && npm run build -w @estudio/runner
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @estudio/api && npm run typecheck -w @estudio/web && npm run typecheck -w @estudio/runner
scripts.test: npm run test -w @estudio/api && npm run test -w @estudio/runner
